fork.rightPanel.plugin.markdownDescription:
Which built-in chat plugin fills the right panel.

The right panel is dedicated to exactly one of them at a time: each plugin contributes a webview view to the shared `forkPlugins` container, shown only while its id is selected here, and the panel's own title row and the view header are removed so the plugin owns the whole surface. Switch with the **Select Chat Plugin** button in the title bar.

Adding a plugin means adding its id to this list; see `extensions/fork-plugins-host/README.md`.
